offering_description.value: AMN supplies temporary nurses, allied health professionals and physicians to hospitals, health systems and other care providers. Its recruiters also fill permanent clinical and leadership roles and manage staffing programs. It provides workforce software and on-demand medical interpretation.

primary_products.value: staffing vendor management software; staff scheduling software; workforce forecasting and analytics software

primary_services.value: travel and local nurse and allied health staffing; temporary physician staffing; permanent recruitment and executive search; managed staffing programs; medical interpretation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, health systems, physician groups, clinics and post-acute care providers; B2G: Public hospitals and public school districts

end_markets.value: acute care; outpatient care; post-acute care; behavioral health; K–12 education

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Temporary clinician assignments billed by hours worked and contracted staffing programs; service fees: Permanent placement and executive search; transaction or usage fees: On-demand interpretation and staffing transactions processed through vendor management platforms; subscription: Access to workforce scheduling and planning software
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; transaction or usage fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Recruits and credentials clinicians and coordinates staffing suppliers for healthcare employers; software / platform: Uses staffing and scheduling data to help healthcare employers source clinicians and plan shifts

geography_served.value: US national: Healthcare and school clients across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Clinical staffing, permanent recruitment, managed staffing, workforce software and medical interpretation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Account teams and recruiters contracting with health systems and other employers; online: Cloud workforce portals and on-demand video and phone interpretation platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State clinician licensing and staffing agency rules, plus HIPAA requirements for patient information

notes: The current mix of subscriptions and usage fees across its software offerings is uncertain.
